I replied in #strategic-random, in a thread on Gideon's message. The Moss digest titled "Moss: Strategic digest 9/30", dated Wednesday, Sep 30, lists Orlavine Medical Supply at 55 seats.

Two caveats. The digest is addressed to Ruth Calloway, and I can't tell whether Gideon can see it. The seat count is operational, so sharing it is allowed, but I should have checked the digest's audience before posting it. My reply also said I couldn't confirm whether it's in his inbox, which was unclear. The search was keyword-only, so I can't rule out other digests that mention Orlavine.
